name: get_aml_score
label: Get AML score (deprecated — use Start AML report)
description: DEPRECATED (2026-07-07): by default this call starts an asynchronous AML report and responds 202 with a rapport_id, status 'pending' and a canonical poll_url; it does not return a score/level in the same call. Kept for backward compatibility; new scenarios should use 'Start AML report (async)' followed by 'Get AML report (poll)' instead. Requires a signed DPA and per-call confirmation sent as headers. The manifest rate limit for report submission is 30 requests per minute. The report is stored for 60 months under the Norwegian Anti-Money Laundering Act.

validate.patternErrorMessage: Organisation number must be exactly 9 digits.

parameters.name: purpose
parameters.label: Purpose of screening
parameters.help: Sent as the DPA purpose (X-FR-Purpose header). Used for the audit trail and rate-limiting policy.

parameters.name: dpa_confirmed
parameters.label: I confirm DPA coverage
parameters.help: Confirm that a signed data processing agreement (DPA) with Firmaradar covers this screening. Sent as X-FR-DPA-Confirmed on every call — this is a per-call assertion you are making, not a setting. The call is rejected without it.

samples.message: aml/score is deprecated: the call now starts an asynchronous AML report. Poll poll_url until status is done/failed, or use POST /api/v1/aml/report directly.
